note: Also, in Colombia, an afternoon snack: tomar las onces.

I have twelve cousins.

sent.en: The number thirteen bus goes to the centre.
My niece is fourteen.

note: Also a girl's fifteenth birthday party: los quince.

sent.en: I will be there in fifteen minutes.

note: One word: diez y seis run together.

sent.en: There are sixteen of us in the group.

sent.es: Tenía {diecisiete} años cuando aprendí a manejar.
sent.en: I was seventeen when I learnt to drive.

sent.es: El vuelo sale a las {dieciocho} horas.
sent.en: The flight leaves at eighteen hundred hours.
It is nineteen degrees.

note: From here on the units are a separate word: treinta y uno.

sent.en: The month has thirty days.
I waited forty minutes.

An hour has sixty minutes.
My grandfather is seventy.

My grandmother is ninety.

note: An irregular hundred, like setecientos and novecientos.

sent.es: Un tinto vale {quinientos} pesos en la calle.
sent.en: A coffee costs five hundred pesos on the street.

note: m. Takes de before a noun: un millón de pesos.

sent.es: El arriendo es un {millón} de pesos.
sent.en: The rent is a million pesos.

note: m. Months take no capital letter in Spanish.

sent.en: I arrived in January.

note: m.

sent.en: My birthday is in February.

note: m.

sent.en: I go back to England in March.

note: m.

note: m.

sent.en: It is very windy in August.

note: m.

sent.en: In October it rains every day.

note: m.

sent.en: I am moving in November.

note: m. The big holiday month in Colombia, lights everywhere.

sent.es: En {diciembre} todo el mundo está de vacaciones.
sent.en: In December everyone is on holiday.

note: m. Near the equator Colombians use it for the rainy season.

sent.en: We are right in the middle of the rainy season.

sent.es: En {primavera} hay flores por todas partes.
sent.en: In spring there are flowers everywhere.

note: m.

sent.en: Autumn in England is very pretty.

sent.en: What are you doing at the weekend?

sent.en: We got in at three in the morning.

sent.en: Wait for me a while.

sent.en: Where are you spending Christmas?

sent.es: Me voy de {vacaciones} a la costa.
sent.en: I am going on holiday to the coast.
